items.title: Investing Rs 10 lakh? Experts decode the right mix
items.description: Investors are facing challenges in allocating a lump sum investment due to uncertainty in equity markets. Wealth managers suggest a combination of equities, debt, and gold for varying risk appetites. For conservative investors, a safer asset mix is recommended, while moderate and aggressive strategies differ significantly. Allocation strategies are tailored according to individual investor profiles and market conditions.

items.title: Why L&T Technology shares jumped 11% to hit the Rs 4,000 level afterQ2 results
items.description: L&T Technology Services shares rose sharply past Rs 4,000 after Q2 results beat expectations, driven by margin expansion, AI-led deal wins and strong sustainability business growth. Management expects a stronger second half of FY27, while Motilal Oswal, Nuvama and Nomura raised their target prices but maintained cautious ratings.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc shares jump 4% after Q2 net profit more than doubles. Why Jefferies cut target price?
items.description: Hindustan Zinc reported a 142% year-on-year jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,412 crore, while revenue rose 77% to Rs 15,093 crore. Despite strong earnings, Jefferies cut its target price to Rs 650 from Rs 750, citing silver price volatility and lower price assumptions for the coming years.

items.title: Anand Rathi Wealth among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 19, five stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 10% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex jumps 800 points, Nifty above 23,050. 5 key factors behind D-Street rebound
items.description: The Sensex and Nifty rallied nearly 1% as strong Q2 earnings, gains in IT stocks, rupee appreciation and attractive largecap valuations lifted sentiment. However, elevated crude oil prices and rising bond yields remain key risks. Analysts expect market movements to remain stock-specific and driven by corporate earnings.

items.title: Vaibhav Vyapaar Shares to list today; Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: Vaibhav Vyapaar shares are scheduled to list on the NSE SME platform on October 21, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 6%. The Rs 42.10 crore issue was subscribed 2.27 times. The NBFC plans to use Rs 32 crore from the proceeds to strengthen its capital base.

items.title: UltraTech Cement shares jump 3% as brokerages revise target prices after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Citi are saying
items.description: Shares of UltraTech Cement increased by 3% after the company reported strong quarterly earnings for Q2 FY27. The company's net profit saw a 21% growth compared to the previous year, driven by operational revenue increases. Jefferies raised its target price for the stock, indicating significant upside potential. Meanwhile, Nomura and Citi slightly lowered their estimates due to rising costs and external economic factors.

items.title: Jio IPO beyond telecom: Why the Ambanis are pitching AI, cloud and 7,220 patents as Jio’s tech future
items.description: Jio Platforms ₹30,213 crore IPO marks a significant shift toward technology-driven digital services. With a focus on leveraging its connectivity through AI and cloud technologies, the company is also highlighting its extensive patent holdings. While Reliance Jio Infocomm continues to generate substantial revenue, the company aspires to broaden its reach into enterprise solutions and diverse digital products.

items.title: HD Fire Protect shares list at 24% premium over IPO price on NSE
items.description: HD Fire Protect shares debuted at a premium of up to 23.6% on Wednesday after its Rs 712 crore IPO attracted 131.70 times subscription. The issue was entirely an offer for sale by promoter shareholders. The company reported a 12% rise in FY26 total income to Rs 505 crore.Do you like this personality?

items.title: Himadri Speciality Chemical among 3 stocks to close crossing below VWAP
items.description: On October 19, the closing prices of three stocks from the Nifty 500 pack fell more than 2% below their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. VWAP represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, weighted by trading volume. A closing price below VWAP indicates that the stock ended the session below its volume-weighted average traded price.

items.title: Jammu & Kashmir Bank among 3 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On October 19, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Union Bank Of India among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On October 19, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge. An uptrend signal occurs when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. “RSI trending up” means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, indicating strengthening momentum in the stock's price. The RSI is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: There is no contingency plan from government to deal with higher fuel price:  RS Sharma
items.description: My own assessment that prices will rise further from here on. Unfortunately there is no contingency plan from Govt on high crude prices, says RS Sharma, Former CMD, ONGC Group

items.title: Stock split alert! Last day to buy JSW Dulux shares to be eligible for 1:10 split
items.description: Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy JSW Dulux’s shares to be eligible for the stock split.

items.title: Negative Breakout: These 8 large-cap stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the NSE large-cap pack, eight stocks' closing prices crossed below their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 19, according to technical scan data from StockEdge. Trading below the 200 DMA is generally considered a negative signal, as it suggests that a stock’s price is below its long-term trend. The 200 DMA is a widely used technical indicator that helps traders assess the overall trend of a stock.

items.title: Sun Pharma to raise Rs 10,000 crore to part-finance Organon deal
items.description: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries plans to raise ₹10,000 crore through two tranches of rupee-denominated bonds. The funds will help refinance bridge loans taken for the Organon acquisition valued at $11.75 billion. The first tranche will amount to ₹7,000 crore with a coupon rate of 8.20%. Institutional investors are expected to participate, including notable companies like SBI Pension Fund and ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Eternal, IREDA, Yes Bank, Trent and Hindustan Zinc
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks experienced a decline as profit-booking occurred amid rising crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 dropped significantly, closing at 22,889 after disappointing corporate earnings. Reliance Industries aims to raise funds through its initial public offering today, which is highly anticipated. Other companies such as IREDA and Yes Bank reported mixed financial results for the quarter. Investors are closely monitoring these developments and their potential market impacts.

items.title: Rs 8 lakh crore selloff! Sensex plunges 1,400 points from day’s peak as bulls lose steam; 3 triggers
items.description: On Wednesday, the Indian stock market saw a significant decline after an initial rise in the morning. Sensex and Nifty both climbed nearly 1% early on, reaching highs of 74,682 and 23,121 respectively. However, the market reversed course in the afternoon session, with selling pressure mounting. By the end of the day, Sensex dropped around 1,400 points from day's high, while Nifty fell below the 22,700 level.

items.title: Vishal Mega Mart shares sink 8% as Q2 margin takes a hit despite profit growth
items.description: Vishal Mega Mart shares fell sharply on Wednesday after the retailer reported a 110-basis-point year-on-year contraction in EBITDA margin to 12.1% in Q2FY27. Net profit rose 3.7% to Rs 157.9 crore, while revenue increased 14% to Rs 3,398.5 crore. The company attributed margin pressure to a shift in festival timing.

items.title: Multibagger alert! PC Jeweller shares jump 6% to fresh 52-week high, rally over 100% in 2026
items.description: PC Jeweller shares hit a fresh 52-week high of Rs 19.13, rising over 100% in 2026 and gaining 44% in a month. The rally follows the company’s repayment of outstanding dues to all 14 consortium banks, achieving debt-free status ahead of schedule and strengthening its balance sheet.

items.title: HD Fire Protect shares list at 23% premium; expert highlights key factors to watch
items.description: HD Fire Protect shares listed at a 23% premium over the IPO issue price of Rs 271, debuting at Rs 334.40 on the BSE and Rs 335 on the NSE. Experts say future performance will depend on customer expansion, margin stability, operating cash flows and demand for fire protection equipment.

items.title: Rs 30,213 crore, 100 minutes, Rs 2.5 lakh crore: How Jio IPO broke 3 records even before listing
items.description: Reliance Industries’ Jio Platforms has set new IPO records, with its Rs 30,213 crore issue becoming India’s largest-ever public offering and getting fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. The IPO surpasses Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870 crore issue in 2024. At the upper end of its Rs 1,065–1,119 price band, Jio Platforms is valued at around Rs 10.3 lakh crore. The issue closes on October 23.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares jump 3% as Jio’s Rs 30,213 crore IPO gets fully subscribed on Day 1. What lies ahead?
items.description: Reliance Industries shares rose on Wednesday as Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213 crore IPO was fully subscribed within an hour of opening. was fully subscribed within an hour of opening. With strong investor demand for the issue, attention is turning to Jio’s valuation, RIL’s diverse business portfolio and the potential value-unlocking opportunities for investors following the much-awaited listing.

items.title: Piramal Finance shares jump 4% as Q2 profit rises 67% YoY to Rs 545 crore, NII jumps 35% YoY
items.description: Piramal Finance shares rose nearly 4% after Q2 FY27 net profit surged 67% year-on-year to Rs 545 crore. Assets under management grew 24%, while retail disbursements increased 34%. The company strengthened its capital base, expanded AI adoption, improved operational efficiency, and appointed former SBI Chairman Dinesh Kumar Khara as Independent Director.

items.title: Missed reversal in IT stocks? Jefferies gives 3 ideas with up to 50% re-rating potential
items.description: Jefferies sees further valuation upside in Indian IT stocks despite a muted sector growth outlook. Infosys and TCS offer over 20% rerating potential, while Sagility could deliver more than 50% in a best-case scenario. The brokerage raised target prices for Infosys and TCS, citing scope for growth expectations to stabilise.

items.title: Bajaj Finance shares fall 3% after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages now expect?
items.description: Bajaj Finance shares dropped on Wednesday after the NBFC reported a 29% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,367 crore. Nomura and Jefferies retained Buy ratings, with Jefferies cutting its target price, while 360 One WAM upgraded the stock to Buy, citing improving risk-reward and strong growth.

items.title: Transrail Lighting shares rally 9% after bagging orders worth Rs 927 crore
items.description: Transrail Lighting shares rose nearly 9% after the company secured fresh orders worth Rs 927 crore, taking its financial year order intake to Rs 3,356 crore. However, foreign institutional investors trimmed their stake in the company during the September 2026 quarter.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A major PSU bank for a 6.3% gain, a mid-cap metal component maker’s stock for a rise of about 6%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Can Jio IPO unlock hidden value in Reliance Industries shares?
items.description: Jio Platforms is hitting the stock market, but could its listing mean more value for Reliance Industries shareholders too? We break down the holding company discount, what Reliance’s stake in Jio is worth, and why the IPO could change how investors look at RIL.

items.title: Sky Gold and Diamonds among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 45% in a month
items.description: On Wednesday, the benchmark Sensex fell 143 points to close at 73,709. Despite the decline, five stocks from the BSE 1000 index hit fresh 52-week highs, marking their highest price levels in the past 12 months. A 52-week high represents the highest price a stock has traded at over the past year and can indicate rising investor interest and increased market activity.

items.title: Market wrap: Infosys, HCL Tech, Bajaj Finance, BSE top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
items.description: Indian markets extended losses for a second session on Wednesday, with the Nifty falling 0.34% to 22,811 and the Sensex slipping 0.19% to 73,710. IT stocks led sectoral gains, with Infosys and HCL Tech topping the gainers, while Bajaj Finance, BSE and Eternal featured among the biggest losers.

items.title: Want exposure to India's biggest banks? Zerodha launches new ETF
items.description: Zerodha Fund House has launched the BSE Top 10 Banks ETF, tracking India’s largest listed banks. The NFO runs from October 12 to October 26, 2026, with a minimum investment of Rs 1,000, offering focused banking exposure.

items.title: CAS swings: Nifty’s indicative price jumps 500 points in seconds, closes higher than pre-CAS level
items.description: The Indian stock market experienced notable volatility during the closing auction, marked by a steep selloff that wiped out more than Rs 8 lakh crore in market capitalization. Despite Sensex and Nifty ending higher than pre-CAS levels, investor sentiment remained cautious due to escalating bond yields and ongoing selling by foreign institutional investors.

items.title: Bears control sentiment. Structural changes control growth. 5 stocks from the water management space
items.description: There is little doubt that the market is facing some fierce headwinds. But remember this: A headwind, however fierce, can only do two things. It can knock share prices down, and it can frighten investors. What it cannot do is stop or slow a structural change that is already underway in the real economy.

items.title: MFs raise stakes in 10 stocks in Q2; shares rally up to 130% in FY27, including 3 multibaggers
items.description: Mutual funds (MFs) shareholding changes often attract market attention, as these institutional investors typically conduct extensive research before making investment decisions. Of the 500 companies in the BSE 500 index, around 351 have reported their shareholding patterns for the September 2026 quarter so far. MFs increased their stakes in 203 of these companies.Interestingly, 47 of these stocks have gained over 30% in FY27 so far. From this list, we highlight 10 stocks that have rallied between 59% and 130% during the period, including three multibaggers. These companies have also witnessed an increase in MF shareholding in the September 2026 quarter compared with the June 2026 quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity).

items.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
items.description: Persistent Systems has opened a qualified institutional placement to raise up to USD 450 million, or about Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company has set the QIP floor price at Rs 5,550 per share and may offer investors a discount of up to 5% under the approved pricing terms.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty ended above pre-closing auction session levels after extreme volatility, despite an Rs 8 lakh crore market selloff. Elevated crude prices, foreign investor outflows and weak market breadth kept sentiment cautious.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Wipro among 5 stock recommendations for Thursday
items.description: Indian equities gave up strong early gains as elevated crude prices and continued FII selling overshadowed optimism surrounding India-US trade negotiations. Profit-booking intensified across autos, financials, metals and realty, reflecting concerns over inflation and margin pressures, while IT showed relative resilience amid improving earnings visibility and renewed investor appetite for the sector. Analysts say resilient Q2 earnings and robust domestic institutional flows remain important market supports, but weak breadth and persistent foreign selling point to continued caution.Here are 5 stock recommendations for Thursday:
